tasks.title: Install Drizzle ORM and PostgreSQL driver
tasks.description: Set up Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL driver and configure the database connection infrastructure for both control-plane and customer databases.
tasks.details:
Install required packages:
- `npm install drizzle-orm@latest pg@latest`
- `npm install -D drizzle-kit@latest @types/pg@latest`

Create database connection infrastructure:
1. Create `src/db/control-plane/connection.ts` - singleton connection to the `robin` control-plane database using DATABASE_URL env var
2. Create `src/db/control-plane/schema/` directory for control-plane table schemas
3. Create `src/db/customer/schema/` directory for customer database schemas
4. Create `drizzle.config.ts` for control-plane migrations
5. Create `drizzle.customer.config.ts` for customer database migrations

Connection pattern:
```typescript
import { drizzle } from 'drizzle-orm/node-postgres';
import { Pool } from 'pg';

const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });
export const db = drizzle(pool);
```

Add npm scripts:
- `db:generate` - generate migrations
- `db:migrate` - run control-plane migrations
- `db:studio` - open Drizzle Studio
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Run `npm run typecheck` to verify types
2. Run `npm run db:generate` to verify schema compilation
3. Write a simple connection test that queries `SELECT 1` against the control-plane database
4. Verify Drizzle Studio opens and can inspect the database

tasks.description: Define the Drizzle schema for control-plane tables: users, organizations, memberships, customers, integration_connections, and customer_sources.
tasks.details:
Create schema files in `src/db/control-plane/schema/`:

1. `users.ts`:
```typescript
export const users = pgTable('users', {
  id: uuid('id').defaultRandom().primaryKey(),
  email: text('email').notNull().unique(),
  name: text('name'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at').defaultNow().notNull(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at').defaultNow().notNull(),
});
```

2. `organizations.ts`:
```typescript
export const organizations = pgTable('organizations', {
  id: uuid('id').defaultRandom().primaryKey(),
  name: text('name').notNull(),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at').defaultNow().notNull(),
});
```

3. `memberships.ts` - user ↔ organization with role enum

4. `customers.ts`:
```typescript
export const customers = pgTable('customers', {
  id: uuid('id').defaultRandom().primaryKey(),
  organizationId: uuid('organization_id').references(() => organizations.id).notNull(),
  name: text('name').notNull(),
  status: text('status', { enum: ['active', 'archived'] }).default('active').notNull(),
  databaseName: text('database_name').notNull().unique(),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at').defaultNow().notNull(),
});
```

5. `integration_connections.ts` - OAuth tokens (encrypted), provider, scopes
6. `customer_sources.ts` - links customers to integration connections with provider-specific selectors

Create `src/db/control-plane/schema/index.ts` to re-export all schemas.

subtasks.title: Create IVFFlat vector index migration for query performance
subtasks.description: Add a Drizzle migration that creates the IVFFlat index on the chunks.embedding column with vector_cosine_ops for optimized similarity queries, including index tuning parameters.
subtasks.details:
Create the pgvector index migration for the customer database schema:

   USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (lists = 100);

   - `lists = 100`: Creates 100 inverted lists (clusters) for approximate search
